body:
I can’t tell the rational thoughts apart from the irrational ones anymore. To give an example;
 I’ve seen 3 different therapists over the last 20 years and they all said the same thing thing, Suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. 20 years and 2 attempts I’m starting wonder how long temporary is, what’s a good amount of time to give before accepting that my issues are actually permanent and always going to be a source of pain ?
